components.required_refinement: Pre-canonical Source/Parse stages must not independently mint canonical ProgramSemanticId. Canonical semantic identity should be derived at deterministic canonical typed IR or an equivalently verified canonical semantic stage; earlier stages carry source/parse/expected-semantic evidence only.

conditional_resource_rule: When a trace crosses a live host-resource boundary, semantic resource identity is insufficient. The effect receipt must bind current handle instance/type/lifetime or generation plus capability authorization state; capability epoch and resource generation epoch are not silently collapsed.
program_semantic_id_rule: Source/parse evidence may predict/reference semantic identity but canonical ProgramSemanticId authority belongs only to a deterministic verified canonical semantic stage. A copied semantic_hash across source/parse/typed_ir is not by itself a derivation proof.
hard_failure_examples: same final state but different lowering_contract_hash
source or parse stage independently asserting canonical semantic identity without derivation proof
same current semantic content but version/history identity silently conflated
resource generation epoch silently replaced by graph or semantic epoch
status snapshot bound to a different final basis
normalization_rule: Implementation-only ids may normalize away only when runtime semantic, canonical typed-IR semantic, compiler-chain contract, executable artifact and applicable resource-lifetime identities remain equivalent under an explicit mapping.
authority_rule: No observability, graph, GWT, source-chain, semantic-id, resource-reference or replay receipt mints execution authority.
